description: This file defines a Flutter widget called FavoritesScreen, which represents the Favorites tab in an app. It displays a static list view with a title and a message indicating no favorites are saved.

classes.name: FavoritesScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders a list view with a title and message, intended as a placeholder for saved recipes in the Favorites tab.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the FavoritesScreen, returning a ListView with padding, a title, and a message indicating no favorites.
